steps.title: Codex review
steps.prompt: Review the diff saved in {{steps.diff.outputs.diff_file}} (the changes from `git diff {{inputs.range}}` in the current directory). Read that file; do not run commands and do not edit any file except your result file. Report a verdict of approve or reject, and each finding with file, line_start, line_end, severity, title and body. Write findings as a JSON array. {{steps.map.outputs.hint}}

steps.title: Gemini review
steps.prompt: Review the diff saved in {{steps.diff.outputs.diff_file}} (the changes from `git diff {{inputs.range}}` in the current directory). Read that file and the source files it touches; do not run commands and do not edit any file except your result file. Report a verdict of approve or reject, and each finding with file, line_start, line_end, severity, title and body. Write findings as a JSON array.
